target.title: fix(model-catalog): keep profile-specific model rows distinct
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When multiple auth profiles expose the same provider/model id, the model catalog and picker currently collapse those rows into one option. For example, two OpenAI profiles that both expose `openai/gpt-5.5` become indistinguishable, so users cannot select the intended account/profile from the picker.

This PR keeps profile-specific rows distinct by including `profileId` in catalog and picker keys, while preserving the existing provider/model key behavior when no profile is attached.

This is the clean replacement for #106271: the old PR branch accumulated unrelated upstream CI-unblock commits while chasing base drift. This branch starts from current upstream `main` (`b0ebb81e89f5217397d409c996e2bbf914623a94`) and carries the GPT picker/model-catalog change plus generated CI companion baselines required by current upstream main.

## Summary

- Include `profileId` in model catalog dedupe keys.
- Preserve `profileId` on discovered catalog entries.
- Include `profileId` in picker option keys and profile hints.
- Refresh generated Swift protocol model and deadcode export baseline reported stale by CI.
- Refresh native i18n source inventory reported stale by CI.

## Evidence

- Current PR head: `5822ae2e54dd12904bcbdd00e6e933f4c9ad1a80`.
- Base: upstream `main` at `b0ebb81e89f5217397d409c996e2bbf914623a94`.
- `git diff --check` passed locally.
- `oxfmt --check src/agents/model-catalog.ts src/agents/model-catalog.types.ts src/flows/model-picker.ts` passed locally.
- `deadcode:exports` passed locally after baseline refresh.
- `protocol:gen`, `protocol:gen:swift`, and `protocol:gen:kotlin` ran locally; committed generated diff is limited to `apps/shared/OpenClawKit/Sources/OpenClawProtocol/GatewayModels.swift`.
- `native:i18n:check`, `android:i18n:check`, and `apple:i18n:check` passed locally after `native:i18n:sync` refreshed `apps/.i18n/native-source.json`.
- Local `verify-fix.mjs` showed the old behavior collapses two `openai/gpt-5.5` rows to one unique key, while the new behavior keeps two distinct keys:
  - `openai/gpt-5.5@openai:zilokki@gmail.com`
  - `openai/gpt-5.5@openai:owndate1`
- The same verification showed picker keys are separate and hints include `profile: <profileId>`.
- GPT picker diff is scoped to 3 files: `src/agents/model-catalog.ts`, `src/agents/model-catalog.types.ts`, `src/flows/model-picker.ts`.

## Boundaries

- No workflow files changed by this PR branch.
- No live config changes.
- No main push.
- No force push.
